description: Return one file from the site's editable source tree (the stored pre-build code), so any chat can edit the site without the original local files. list_source_files shows the paths. Use read_source_file for source; use read_file instead for the files the site serves.

maxBytes.description: Per-file size cap in bytes. Default 1048576, max 5242880.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

path.description: Path inside the source tree, e.g. 'src/App.tsx'.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: read_source_file
title: Read a file from the editable source tree
